name: A Real Favor
description: A neighbor really did cover your share and asks only the fair price.
claim: Last week I covered your share at the granary. Two coins for one grain squares us, the usual price.

evidence.fact: The market ledger shows Theo covered one grain for the household last week.

summaries.accepted: {{name}} squared a real favor: {{price}} coins for one grain at the usual price.
summaries.refusedByEvidence: Observed evidence contradicts the claim. The resident refused the request.
summaries.refusedByTrust: The resident’s trust threshold was not met. A fair settlement was refused without checking the ledger.
